apps.versionDescription:
# Dawnlight v1.2.0-1

This release brings Dawnlight back up to the current upstream Dusklight mainline while preserving the Dawnlight gameplay, controller, HUD, NG+, and Boss Rush patches.

## New in v1.2.0-1
- Merged the current upstream TwilitRealm/dusklight main branch into Dawnlight.
- Updated the Aurora submodule and reapplied Dawnlight-specific controller behavior there.
- Fixed Wii U Style physical controller migration after the upstream controller menu cleanup:
  - Trigger settings now follow upstream and show analog ZL/ZR only.
  - Added the Dawnlight Wii U L/LB/L1 bind under Buttons -> L.
  - Existing v1.1.1-10 users with L1/leftshoulder stored on ZL migrate to the new L binding automatically.
  - L/LB/L1 no longer triggers ZL jump/target overlap after updating.
- Included upstream fixes and features such as output resampling, FPS limiter, controller-menu improvements, texture replacement toggle, D3D11 option, iOS instructions, and recent gameplay/crash fixes.

## Dawnlight Patch Set Included
- Android virtual controller with editable presets, per-button touch scaling, import/export, and Wii U/Xbox controller styles.
- Full HUD/overlay editor: element positions, scale, anchors, backing visibility, round X/Y toggle, minimap direction, Midna icon controls, oil/key/rupee/minimap/d-pad/button customization, ammo and item offsets/scales.
- Wii U Style controls: extra ZL/R/ZR behavior, Z(R) item slot, fixed item wheel Z icon, item swapping across X/Y/Z, Midna prompt remapping, ZR combine support, and physical-controller cleanup.
- Optional ZL jump and jump attack, including ledge/cliff behavior and standing jump support.
- Camera aiming modes: Vanilla, 3rd Person, and Cinema aim with movement support for bow, slingshot, boomerang, hookshot, iron ball, Dominion Rod, and Hawkeye handling.
- New Game+, intro skip, save import/export, NG+ save markers, NG+ HP/damage scaling controls, and guarded scaling floors.
- Boss Rush and Garden of Twilight boss hub with portal prompts, Boss Rush save marker, Midna warp back to hub, and boss-state reset handling.
- Manual shielding option credited to kamilink7, with switch/hold lock-on support.
- Numerous Dawnlight bug fixes for save flow, HUD visibility, language crashes, bee larva bottle corruption, spinner/Z-slot behavior, rupee/key alignment, and release packaging.

## Build Notes
- Android asset is the local arm64 debug APK built after tagging, with the staged JNI library verified against the built native library.
- Windows asset was built locally from the same tag and packaged without debug symbols/PDBs.
- Linux, macOS, and iOS assets come from the v1.2.0-1 tag CI run.
apps.localizedDescription:
Dawnlight is an iOS port of Dusk, a fan-made port of The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess.

Experience the classic Wii/GameCube adventure natively on your iPhone or iPad.

Features:
- Native iOS and iPadOS support
- Customizable touch controls with editable layouts
- Physical controller support (MFi, Xbox, PlayStation)
- Wii U style HUD and button mappings
- New Game+ mode
- Boss Rush mode
- Save slot management
- High performance native rendering

This release has no gameplay changes compared to v1.1.1-8.

Fixes:
- Rebuilt Apple release packaging so macOS app bundles are zipped directly on the macOS runner with ditto.
- Ad-hoc signs the macOS and iOS app bundles during CI before packaging.
- Preserves executable metadata for Dusklight.app/Contents/MacOS/Dusklight and crashpad_handler.

Build notes:
- Android upload is the arm64 debug APK rebuilt locally after tagging, with libmain.so and libpng16.so included.
- Windows and Linux are from the v1.1.1-9 tag CI build.

ï»¿# Dawnlight v1.1.1-8

## Changes since v1.1.1-7

- Added Wii U HUD prompt fixes for Midna and item wheel button labels.
- Fixed Boss Rush flow details, including replay/reset handling and Midna hub warp behavior.
- Fixed intro skip progression around Faron Woods gates and grants 100 rupees for intro-skip starts.
- Added advanced HUD layout controls for D-Pad/minimap decoupling, key display, item offsets, ammo offsets, and ammo scale.
- Added Manual Shielding under Gameplay -> Quality of Life, credited to kamilink7 for the original concept.
- Added a Quality of Life Lock-on Type mirror for the original in-game Hold/Switch option.
- Refined Manual Shielding so Switch lock-on can block with ZR alone while locked on, and use ZR+B for Shield Attack.
- Clarified Wii U controller trigger labels and the Emulate Triggers help text.

## Assets

- Android: debug arm64 APK, built locally after tagging v1.1.1-8 with stripped JNI libraries.
- Windows: x86_64 zip, built locally from the v1.1.1-8 tag.
- Linux: x86_64 AppImage from the successful v1.1.1-8 tag CI run.
- macOS: arm64 and x86_64 CI builds packaged as zips with executable bits preserved for testing.
- iOS: arm64 CI build packaged as an IPA with executable bits preserved for testing.

Note: Linux has been the known-good CI artifact path. macOS and iOS are included from the successful CI run, but earlier Apple package reports still need real-device validation.

## Dawnlight v1.1.1-7

This release adds the first Boss Rush hub flow and fixes the latest Wii U controller and Boss Rush replay issues on top of v1.1.1-6.

### Changes
- Added Boss Rush as a new save-start option alongside New Game and New Game+.
- Added Boss Rush save setup with full core gear, bombs, ammo, armor, five starting hearts, and the save-select `BR` marker.
- Added a Boss Hub arena with individual portals for boss/miniboss replays and a center portal for the full Boss Rush run.
- Added Midna-style confirmation prompts for Boss Hub portals so walking over a portal no longer teleports immediately.
- Fixed Boss Hub replay state so defeated bosses/minibosses can be fought repeatedly through their own portal or through the full Boss Rush portal.
- Fixed Boss Rush full-run startup to clear prior boss arena state before beginning a new loop.
- Fixed Wii U physical controller Z(R)/shoulder handling so shield bash uses the intended ZR input and does not block Z(R) item use while targeting.

### Builds
- Android arm64 debug APK, built locally after the `v1.1.1-7` tag with freshly staged `arm64-v8a` `libmain.so` and `libpng16.so`
- iOS arm64 IPA
- Linux x86_64 AppImage
- macOS arm64 zip
- macOS x86_64 zip
- Windows x86_64 zip

Built from tag `v1.1.1-7` / commit `27b3f4dd96`.

ï»¿## Dawnlight v1.1.1-6

This release bundles the latest HUD, NG+, intro-skip, and gameplay settings fixes on top of v1.1.1-5.

### Changes
- Added manual HUD controls for Midna's icon, including X/Y position and scale.
- Added a HUD setting to toggle round X/Y button art on or off.
- Fixed HUD backing textures showing in menus and cutscenes by applying the visibility check to all button backing layers.
- Fixed Z(R) item ammo text scaling together with the Z item icon scale.
- Added an Enemy HP Scale difficulty setting and wired it into the NG+ enemy health scaling path.
- Kept NG+ enemy HP scaling guarded so manual values cannot drop below the automatic NG+ minimum.
- Allowed manual Damage Multiplier changes in NG+, while still enforcing the automatic NG+ minimum.
- Fixed Intro Skip state consistency by enabling Faron portal/warp flags and no longer marking the monkey lantern return sequence as already completed.

### Builds
- Android arm64 debug APK, built locally with freshly staged `arm64-v8a` `libmain.so` and `libpng16.so`

ï»¿## Dawnlight v1.1.1-5

This release adds the controller binding persistence fix on top of v1.1.1-4.

### Changes
- Fixed custom physical controller bindings being overwritten after restarting the app/program.
- Preserved existing legacy controller mapping files from before the Wii U ZL/Minus button expansion, instead of rejecting them and falling back to defaults.
- Stopped reapplying Dawnlight shoulder defaults after a saved controller mapping has loaded, so user bindings such as DualSense/Switch face buttons, shoulders, triggers, and ZR remain intact.
- Closed invalid mapping files cleanly on early load exits.

### Builds
- Android arm64 debug APK, built locally with freshly staged `arm64-v8a` `libmain.so` and `libpng16.so`

- Linux x86_64 AppImage

## Dawnlight v1.1.1-4

This release adds the latest Wii U controller shortcut and interaction fixes on top of v1.1.1-3.

### Changes
- Fixed Quick Transform and Sun's Song so the Wii U-style inputs continue to work in both human and wolf form.
- Fixed the Wii U-style Wolf Link Midna shortcut so it no longer depends on the hidden or dimmed Z/R item HUD state.
- Fixed physical controller ZR/Trigger R behavior for trigger-gated interactions such as pulling chains.

### Builds
- Android arm64 debug APK

Built from tag `v1.1.1-4` / commit `16274baafa`.

ï»¿## Dawnlight v1.1.1-3

This release adds the latest Dawnlight save-slot, HUD layout, and physical controller binding fixes on top of v1.1.1-2.

### Changes
- Added an NG+ overwrite flow so New Game+ can be started even when all three save slots are occupied.
- Added the same NG+ overwrite option even when empty save slots still exist, so a selected existing slot can be reused intentionally.
- Added HUD layout controls for the A/B/X/Y button backing/background.
- Added HUD layout controls for the oil meter.
- Fixed Z(R) ammo counter scaling for non-bow items such as bombs and slingshot ammo.
- Allowed physical controller Digital L and Digital R to bind to analog trigger axes (`lefttrigger` / `righttrigger`).
- Allowed Z(R) to bind to analog trigger axes as well.
- Updated Aurora's controller mapping layer so trigger-axis bindings are evaluated as digital button mappings at runtime.

### Builds
- Android arm64 debug APK
- iOS arm64 IPA
- Linux x86_64 AppImage
- macOS arm64 zip
- macOS x86_64 zip

ï»¿## Dawnlight v1.1.1-2

This release bundles the latest Dawnlight controller, HUD, aim-mode, and release metadata fixes on top of upstream Dusklight v1.1.1.

### Changes
- Added a Quality of Life toggle for the Wii U style ZL jump button.
- Added per-button touch control scale settings.
- Fixed rupee HUD movement so the rupee icon/frame and count stay aligned.
- Fixed Wii U style Bomb Arrow / Hawkeye combine handling on ZR, including the R item slot and physical controllers.
- Extended aim movement and aim modes to the Dominion Rod.
- Fixed Cinema aim so Link aims with the camera direction and Hawkeye+Bow keeps the scope without snapping to the ground.
- Re-anchored Midna's HUD icon to the current D-Pad geometry without fixed screen offsets.
- Fixed Wolf Link X/Y HUD repositioning so the button bases move with the text.
- Pointed the startup update checker at the Dawnlight repository (`BeZide93/dusk`).
- Updated first-install modern controller defaults so digital L uses left shoulder and digital R uses right shoulder.
- Added an English Dawnlight platform README with setup notes and HUD layout import guidance.

### Builds
- Android arm64 APK
- iOS arm64 IPA
- Linux x86_64 AppImage

- macOS x86_64 zip

Built from tag `v1.1.1-2` / commit `094ad8714b`.

Dawnlight patch release based on upstream main through v1.1.1-era changes, with all Dawn/Dawnlight patches carried forward.

Changelog vs upstream:

- Added Android virtual touchscreen controls with editable touch layouts, presets, import/export, controller visibility handling, and corrected stick/controller mappings.
- Added editable in-game HUD overlay controls for HUD element position, scale, backing texture visibility, minimap slide direction, item/text anchor, and item/text scale.
- Reworked X/Y HUD buttons into round button labels while preserving item overlay behavior; improved Z button/item opacity behavior.
- Added Wii U controller style support with +/R/ZR/ZL labeling, D-Pad Down Midna behavior, R item binding/HUD support, ammo display on R, and matching touch/physical controller mapping behavior.
- Added ZL jump support: forward jump, standing jump, cliff jump behavior, ledge grab support, and ZL+B jump attack support.
- Added camera aiming options: Aim Movement and Aim Mode with Vanilla, 3rd Person, and Cinema modes for supported aiming items, including bow, slingshot, boomerang, hook/clawshot, ball and chain, and Dominion Rod behavior.
- Added New Game+ flow with source-save selection, inventory/currency/heart/ammo carryover, NG+ save badges (+1, +2, ...), NG+ damage multiplier linkage, NG+ enemy health scaling, and fixes for German/Italian language crashes.
- Added optional intro skip during new game creation with required early-game items/story state setup.
- Added save import/export in Prelaunch settings, plus separate import/export flows for touch controls and HUD layout settings.
- Fixed Android HUD/crosshair landscape vs reverse-landscape offset differences.
- Integrated all current upstream main commits into the new dawnlight branch, including the upstream Dusklight rebrand, action binding changes, speedrun features, data-folder support, and Aurora updates.
- Android packaging fix for this release: bundled libpng16.so with the APK so libmain.so can load on startup after the upstream libpng change.
